scope: latest alpha finite conditional exchange hypergraph; no candidate score or replay
proof_scope_of_pruning: finite pool, guaranteed factor_lower completion, fixed seed, preserving all originally completed mandatory targets; does not rule out globally better solutions that sacrifice some mandatory or new unseen columns
closure_definition: fixed seed; collect conflicting original observations; for every originally completed target whose all witnesses lie in union removed and not covered by fixed seed, add every nonconflicting-with-seed new completion column; repeat. This deliberately ignores mutual conflicts among restoration alternatives and is a finite superset.
interpretation_of_component_sizes: Interval components include original/new columns; mandatory augmentation connects all completion incidences including the three initially missing target resources. It excludes science, REQ and Jain resource incidences.
